name: Sora Studio Builder 🎬
description_md:
# What You Get

- A master prompt that builds a complete Sora Video API web app—create, track, remix, and download AI videos with no frameworks.

- Prewired UI logic for auto-refresh, live progress, and instant thumbnail-to-video gallery loading.

- Lightweight vanilla stack (HTML/CSS/JS + Tailwind) with .env key management and one-click local server startup.

If you want access to the ready-to-clone code and hours of Claude Code resources, check out the Early AI-dopters Community
